# Prescriptive lessons — dirk-laukens × tritone-substitution-licks

15 notes across 3 chord_qualities (min7, dom7, maj7). Focused lick collection on the tritone-sub idiom: substitute the V7 with the dom7 a tritone away, then solo with one of four options (dom7 arpeggio, dom9 arpeggio, major pentatonic, Mixolydian) over the substitute. Altered tones b9, #11, b13 emerge automatically. Sixth of substitute root is approach-note-only (Bb avoidance over Db7). Resolution via chromaticism into the I maj7.
